title: digitaria microbachne
intro: Digitaria microbachne, commonly known as finger grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. The health benefits of Digitaria microbachne include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and lower blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Digitaria microbachne include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
